definition: An AgentHandoff is a single instance of one agent delegating part or all of a task to another agent.
notes: An AgentHandoff connects a sourceAgentRun to a (possibly not-yet-known) targetAgentRun
An AgentHandoff may fail, succeed, or be canceled
An AgentHandoff is not itself an AgentRun; it describes the transition between two AgentRuns
examples: A supervisor agent routing a request to a specialist agent
An agent escalating a conversation to a human-facing agent
One agent invoking another over an agent-to-agent protocol
counterExamples: A ToolCall (invoking a function, not another agent)
The receiving agent's own AgentRun once it has started
